item.title: LOT-167: PageNavigation exactness flag (honest list paging)
item.body:
LOT-167 (implements FEAT-003 #147, proposed by Bybifok; related bug #104)

Closes #279
Claim: mac/w6-167-sonnet (2026-10-28)

**Problem.** A forum-list pager is a window (`1 … 10 20 … 100 500`); its last link was taken as the page count, so a list could offer a fake last page.

**Cause.** `PageNavigation` had `last` only, with no way to say whether it is exact.

**What changed, and why this wide.**
- `PageNavigation.isExact` (HFRModels): default `false`, `Codable` with `decodeIfPresent`, so older records decode as lower bound.
- `TopicListPager` (HFRParsing, the only builder of list navigation): exact only when entries are `1…N` with `N < 10` (HFR shows 1-10 then tens, so nothing hides) or when there is no pager. Anything else is a lower bound. The `N < 10` inference is documented as pending capture in the spec.
- Docs: LOT-167 spec, new FEAT-003 spec, HFR-PROTOCOL §6c LOT-167, FEATURES.md status, CHANGELOG-LEGACY row 22. Not in scope: the app disabling "Dernière page".
- `docs/LOTS.md` has no status cell any more (state lives on the issues), so no row edit.

**Tests** (Swift Testing; all fail to compile without the change, `isExact` does not exist, and the parser ones also fail on behaviour):
- `recordWrittenBeforeTheFlagDecodesAsLowerBound`, `paginationIsALowerBoundUnlessSaidExact` (model, Codable round trip, default).
- `windowedPagerIsLowerBound` (R04, R05a, R05b), `shortPagerIsExact` (R08-2, R50b), `exactnessRule` (shapes), `rowCountBeatsThePagerWindow` (R04 row count 84 / 35634 vs last link 500, per the legacy oracle), MP list R13u1 exact; R13c (no pager) exact.
- `swift test` green locally (372 + others); `check-lot-deps.py` 0 violations; markdownlint passes.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_014QH2CHteTFWfkJGeSNGpSW

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Pagination now identifies whether a page count is exact. Lists without a pager on page 1 and short, consecutive page links starting at page 1 are marked exact; other pager ranges are treated as lower bounds.
* **Bug Fixes**
  * Saved pagination data without exactness information continues to load and is treated as inexact.
* **Documentation**
  * Updated pagination guidance to explain how exact page counts are determined.

**Adversarial review (Opus, ext/opus-helper1, independent of the author): APPROVE** — head 61556d6f716f5cc4fc3779ea496a9d8d56fe31ad

1. **Low** `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` (§6c LOT-167, first line): this line says the tests `windowedPagerIsLowerBound`, `shortPagerIsExact`, `exactnessRule` and `rowCountBeatsThePagerWindow` are in `TopicListParserTests`. They are in the new suite `TopicListPagerExactnessTests`, so a reader who searches the named suite finds none of them. The `noPagerHeader` test is not cited at all. Fix: name the right suite and add `noPagerHeader`.
2. **Low** `docs/features/FEAT-003.md` (Edge cases): the text says "Empty list or no pager: one page, exact". The code (`TopicListPager.swift:21-24`), the spec and the test `noPagerHeader` say the count is exact only when the URL names page 1 or no page. Fix: add "on page 1; a later page stays a lower bound".

**Checked**
- `swift test` on Linux: 966 tests in 111 suites, all pass. `check-lot-deps.py`: 0 violations. All CI checks are green except `Analyze (swift)`, which is still queued.
- Spec: the key is `isExact` and decoding uses `decodeIfPresent(...) ?? false`. With explicit `CodingKeys` the synthesized `encode` stays consistent.
- Mutations, each reverted:
  - `decode` instead of `decodeIfPresent`: `recordWrittenBeforeTheFlagDecodesAsLowerBound` fails (keyNotFound).
  - `<=` instead of `< windowSize`: `exactnessRule` fails.
  - No-header case always exact: `noPagerHeader` fails on page=2.
- Every builder of `PageNavigation` was checked: `TopicListPager` (forum lists, favourites, search, and the MP list through `PrivateMessageListParser`) and the hop branch of `TopicListParser:103`, which defaults to not exact. The app does not read `last`, `lastPath` or `isExact` yet.
- Pager text read from each capture:
  - R04: 1-10, then tens and hundreds.
  - R05a: 1, then 10-20 and tens.
  - R05b: 1, 100, then 500-510 and tens.
  - R08-2: 1. R50b: 1-2. R13u1 and R13u1b: 1-7.
  - R13c: no header; its URL is page=1.
- The window always shows the current page's block of ten one by one, starting at 1 on page 1. So the rule "1…N with N<10 is exact" is a sound inference, and it is marked as pending capture.
- The oracle R04 `maxTopicPage` values match the test (row 1: 84, row 8: 35634). The legacy citation `ObjCTopicListParser.m:172-252` matches the pager code.
- Changed Swift lines are all ≤140 characters, the public API has doc comments, and module boundaries are respected.
- The PR has `Closes #279` and `Claim: mac/w6-167-sonnet`, which matches the issue's claim.
